author: kedhareswer
description: Designer portfolio website template built from colourful file folders and frosted glass: folder-tab cover, chapter catalog, tilting about card with timeline, filterable work cabinet with a details sheet, process steps, testimonials and contact, with a sliding sticky nav and dark mode. React, one file, no dependencies. Install the code: npx shadcn@latest add https://21st.dev/r/kedhareswer/folder-tab-portfolio-template
